title: Boundary Binary Search
summary: Search an ordered candidate range for the first or last position where a monotonic condition changes, while keeping that boundary inside the candidate interval.
recognition_signals: one comparison can discard half the remaining candidates
the contract asks for first, last, lower bound, upper bound, or insertion position
core_rules: Choose and keep one interval convention consistently.
A midpoint that could still be the requested boundary must remain in the candidate interval.
Every rejected midpoint must be excluded so the interval strictly shrinks.
structural_steps: initialize an interval containing every possible answer
keep the half that can still contain the requested boundary

common_confusions.distinction: Boundary binary search often searches positions in already ordered data. Monotonic-predicate search applies the same boundary logic to an answer space defined by a feasibility test.
